name: Cyanotype Photogram
desc: Specimens laid on a hand-coated sheet through a twenty-minute exposure — nothing holds still that long, so each one smears its own penumbra into the Prussian blue as it drifts, the coating's brush edges and mottle printing right along with them, the tray forever washing the whole thing back.

energy.doc: UV intensity and printing contrast — how hard the sun drives the iron blue

density.doc: how many specimens are laid on the sheet (3 to 9), each with its own stem

speed.doc: rate multiplier on the drift, the exposure and the wash

hue.doc: chemistry hue — 208 is iron blue; carries paper, toning and specimens with it

wash.doc: how hard the tray works — how fast the image washes back and how far it bleeds

act.doc: multi-minute program: the sun comes and goes / a long hard burn / cloud shadow crossing, the print stalling and racing

style.doc: aesthetic: iron blue on rag / warm Van Dyke brown / neutral matte platinum, long scale / split-toned, cool lights and warm violet shadows / Sabattier reversal with bronzed highlights

seed.doc: deterministic sheet — coating edges and mottle, specimen forms, stems
